entry.title: Moody’s upgrades retail and apparel outlook as tariffs ease
entry.summary: The firm now expects “solid household finances” to lead to more stability in the sector, although rising energy costs and geopolitical risks are still a factor.

entry.title: Saks channels ‘main character energy’ for first post-bankruptcy holiday
entry.summary: A few months after its parent company exited Chapter 11, a leaner Saks Fifth Avenue is out to show it still has holiday heft.

entry.title: Toy prices jump 4.2% ahead of the holidays
entry.summary: The September price bump came amid a “tough” inflation report, with the overall Consumer Price Index up 0.6%.

entry.title: Target wants more efficient stores. An upgraded employee app could help.
entry.summary: The retailer’s myDay app features a newly customizable home screen functionality and will soon include access to AI-backed insights.

entry.title: Lululemon restructures raw materials team, lays off 7 people
entry.summary: The changes came in August, a spokesperson told Retail Dive, just a few weeks before the arrival of new CEO Heidi O’Neill.

entry.title: Bealls to debut mobile app
entry.summary: The app is intended to create a more connected shopping experience across channels, while also supporting the retailer’s strategy around loyalty.

entry.title: The Weekly Closeout: The RealReal secures fresh financing, Roots buyout advances
entry.summary: The resale marketplace refinanced to help strengthen its balance sheet, while the apparel brand's shareholders approved its acquisition by Marquee Brands.

entry.title: Nordstrom Rack comes back to San Francisco
entry.summary: The off-price retailer left its Union Square location three years ago but is reopening a 51,500-square-foot store in fall 2027 as the city’s retail revitalization continues.

entry.title: Bath & Body Works expands partnership to all Ulta stores for the holidays
entry.summary: Pink Suede is back as a limited-edition scent exclusive to Ulta. Meanwhile, customers can shop a curated selection of seasonal products at the beauty retailer through Dec. 26.

entry.title: Halloween without candy? What shoppers are cutting from budgets this year
entry.summary: Nearly two-thirds of shoppers plan to skip some purchases this year, including staple items like costumes and candy, a new LendingTree survey finds.
